slots.name: gala holders
slots.sentence: The firm managing President Trump’s “$Trump” coin announced it would be hosting an “exclusive” gala for the top 185 holders of the coin, featuring the president as a speaker.

slots.name: VIP holders
slots.sentence: The webpage also included that the top 29 qualifying holders are eligible for an exclusive “VIP Reception” at the gala “with your favorite President and one of the Legends.”

slots.name: gala legends
slots.sentence: “An evening with 3 Legends and President Donald J. Trump — plus a private meet & greet with a legend to be announced,” the description of the event read, adding, “No attendees will be granted a private meet & greet with the President.”

slots.name: gold watch recipients
slots.sentence: An 18-karat Trump gold watch is promised for the top four holders of the coin.

slots.name: attendance cutoff
slots.sentence: In order to be eligible to attend, individuals must rank above 186th place on a leaderboard when the eligibility window ends on Nov. 12.

slots.name: private meetings allowed
slots.sentence: A disclaimer in smaller font below stated, “there will be no private meetings with the President. No gifts will be accepted.”
